plain: The legal status of being a foreigner.

webster.text: The state of being an alien.

example.quote: As truly might it be said, that the exercise of the power of prescribing the rule by which foreigners shall be naturalized, is against the law of alienage, while it is, in fact, only to put them in a situation to cease to be the subject of that law.
example.cite: Alexander Hamilton, Opinion as to the Constitutionality of the Bank of the United States, Feb. 23, 1791
